conflicts.permit: We may share certain marketing metrics including Personal Information, anonymous (de-identified) information, and statistical information derived from your use of the Services, with our business partners for any purpose, including to help improve our services and determine the effectiveness of certain advertising campaigns.
conflicts.prohibit: Those business partners shall be bound to uphold the same standards of security and confidentiality that we have promised to you in this Privacy Policy, and they will only use your contact data and other Personal Information to carry out their specific business obligations to Everseat.
conflicts.situation: Sharing a user's Personal Information with business partners for purposes other than carrying out specific business obligations to Everseat (e.g., for any purpose).
conflicts.reason: One sentence strictly restricts business partners to using Personal Information only for specific business obligations to Everseat, while another permits sharing it with them 'for any purpose'.
